thread:
Liam (AE): HightideBank sent back the SIG with ~120 Qs. They highlighted data-residency, SSO/SAML, and pen test windows as blockers. They asked for per-question evidence and a short ops note for prod/private. Can we split and confirm owners?

Asha (Solutions Eng): I can take data-residency + SSO mapping. Will create a sheet with links to artifacts and short answer snippets. ETA tomorrow morning.

Tom (Security): I'll own pen test schedule, vuln mgmt, and logging/retention answers. Need to confirm our standard retention windows for logs in Private.

Ben (Sales Eng): Procurement asked for an official line on whether customer-managed keys are available for Private + whether we support dedicated HSM clusters. They want a short bullet for the commercial team.

Hightide (HightideBank): Thanks. For Q5 they want explicit region list and an attestation that data-at-rest will not leave the UK/EU. Also Q32 wants SAML metadata example and assertion attributes.

Asha (Solutions Eng): For regions: for Private deployments we respect customer infra; for Hosted we have eu-west-1 + eu-west-2 locations. I'll add a statement: "Data for Private deployments remains in-customer infrastructure; hosted regions available: eu-west-1, eu-west-2" with a diagram.

Asha (Solutions Eng): For SAML: sample metadata + attribute map: email, uid, groups. I'll attach a snippet and example assertion.

Tom (Security): Logging: default retention for operational logs in Hosted is 90 days; for Private we provide log retention configs and recommended 365-day / archive options. Will include sample log-config.toml.

Tom (Security): Pen tests: we run annual third-party pentests for Hosted; for Private, customers can supply their own pentest schedule. We also offer a "coordinated scan" window and an engineer point-of-contact. Will draft Q88 response.

Ben (Sales Eng): HSM/KMS one-liner: "Customer-managed KMS supported in Private; BYOK/HSM integrations supported as a Professional Services engagement (time & materials)." Good enough? Procurement needs to paste it in RFI now.

Liam (AE): That's perfect. Add an estimated PS ballpark: 3-5 weeks + one-time setup fee. Keep short.

Asha (Solutions Eng): Uploading draft sheet: https://sheets.redwood/s/HTD-1745551234 (view: sales,security). Marked Q5, Q32, Q47 as done; Q77 (third-party vendor mgmt evidence) needs a doc from legal.

DocBot: File uploaded: "dataflow-uk-eu.pdf" -> /shared/sales/evidence/1745551234/dataflow-uk-eu.pdf (https://files.redwood/sales/1745551234/dataflow-uk-eu.pdf) :white_check_mark:

Tom (Security): I'll attach the latest vuln scan summary (hosted) and a redactable private scan template we give customers. Reminder: redact IPs before sending.

Hightide (HightideBank): For pen tests they asked about windows for testing (we prefer Sep-Nov). Can you provide an SOW note about supporting their scheduled pen test?

Tom (Security): Yes. SOW note: "Redwood will provide an ops contact, scan configuration, and support for validated testing windows. For Private deployments, Redwood performs advisory support; customer owns final scope and artifact sharing." I'll add to the Q88 cell.

Asha (Solutions Eng): Also flag Q12 (data deletion/ERASURE). Add our retention + deletion flow and a snippet:

```
# deletion flow
POST /admin/tenants/<id>/erase -> async job -> purge object store + rotate keys
```

Tom (Security): Good. I'll also add the audit log exemplar for Q47 showing S3 write-once copies + syslog forwarding.

Ben (Sales Eng): Once sheet + artifacts are ready, I'll assemble a one-page "SIG response pack" for Hightide legal and procurement. Want to include the PS estimate and a note about SOC2 + the SOC2 summary doc.

DocBot: SOC2 summary available at /shared/sales/evidence/1745551234/SOC2-Summary-2025.pdf (https://files.redwood/sales/1745551234/SOC2-Summary-2025.pdf)

Asha (Solutions Eng): Quick q: Hightide asked if we support customer KMS key rotation cadence policies. We have defaults but can be customer-controlled in Private. I'll include the default rotation: 90d workload, 365d master.

Hightide (HightideBank): Can you also include an example command to rotate a key via API? They want to understand automation.

Asha (Solutions Eng): Example:

```
POST /kms/keys/<key-id>/rotate
{"rotationPeriodDays":90}
```

I'll include in Q14 artifact.

Tom (Security): Heads-up: for Q77 (vendor mgmt) legal needs the supplier risk assessment template. Tagging legal to attach.

Liam (AE): Ownership recap: Asha -> Q5/Q12/Q14/Q32 + sheet; Tom -> Q47/Q77/Q88 + scans; Ben -> packaging + procurement line; Liam -> final send to Hightide.

Ben (Sales Eng): I'll draft the 1-pager and share the drive link when ready.

Asha (Solutions Eng): Sheet link: https://sheets.redwood/s/HTD-1745551234 (same). Marked items that need legal: Q77.

DocBot: Evidence bundle will be generated at 1745553500: https://files.redwood/sales/1745551234/package.zip

Tom (Security): Quick note: before we deliver, I'll run a redaction pass on the scan pdf and remove internal hostnames.

Hightide (HightideBank): Appreciate the clarity. Expecting the pack by EOD tomorrow.

Liam (AE): Thanks everyone. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:
